name: Alex Example
headline: Senior Programme Manager | Enterprise delivery, regulated industries
summary: Programme manager with 9 years delivering multi-team technology and operations change in logistics and healthcare. Ran portfolios up to EUR 12M and 60 people across four countries, with a record of recovering late programmes and landing them within revised budget. Comfortable owning the plan, the governance and the difficult conversation. PRINCE2 and SAFe RTE certified.

items.title: Senior Programme Manager
items.company_line: Northwind Logistics | Rotterdam, Netherlands | Mar 2022 - Present
bullets: Own a EUR 12M warehouse-automation programme across 3 sites and 6 vendor teams; delivered phase 1 on time and 4% under budget
Recovered a 9-month-late customs-platform migration by re-baselining scope with the CFO and cutting 14 low-value features; went live 11 weeks after re-baseline
Introduced a fortnightly portfolio review and a single risk register; escalations to the steering committee fell 60% in two quarters
Manage 4 project managers; two promoted within 18 months

items.title: Project Manager

bullets: Delivered an electronic-patient-record rollout to 11 clinics (2,300 users) with zero unplanned downtime during cut-over
Ran vendor selection and a EUR 3.4M contract negotiation; secured a 12% reduction against the initial quote
Built the change-management plan (training, super-users, floor-walking) that took adoption to 94% within 30 days
